summary: Frontend-only regression after iter31 hero/navbar polish. All 6 requested checks PASSED: (1) ShieldPlaceholder SVG visible with FSC+2026 gradient when nav_shield_url is empty, (2) hero-bg-image and hero-foreground-image both load (complete=true, naturalWidth>0), foreground inline style is `width: 38%; z-index: 5;`, (3) no overlap: edition right=1020px, fg left=1190px, gap=170px (>0), (4) cursive 'Torneo Internacional' tagline rendered (display:block, visible, w=327 h=48) above the foreground (z-30 on navbar), (5) /admin/home shows NAVBAR (LOGO + ESCUDO) section with nav-shield-upload + nav-logo-upload, and HERO — IMÁGENES section with hero-bg-upload + hero-fg-upload after admin login, (6) Plane Crash webfont loaded via document.fonts API; Neo Sans is a fallback chain (system fallback to Exo 2/Barlow/Inter — by design, not a bug).
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is now ~407 lines including a child CategoryColumn component — still under the 700-line threshold but trending up; if more sections are added consider extracting Hero/Stats/Finales/Region/Footer into separate components.
ShieldPlaceholder SVG uses textContent 'FSC' / '2026' — looks good as a no-asset default. Consider exposing fill colors via props if the CMS later needs theme overrides.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter32 = pure visual regression after iter31 fixes (SVG shield placeholder, fg width 38%, navbar z-30, nav_logo_url default empty). All passed.
